events.context: User requests deletion of Claude auth logout information while preserving skills and agent settings
System provides multiple methods for safely deleting auth information, including commands like ls, rm, find, cp, and claude auth logout
User runs find commands to delete auth files: find ~/.config -path "*/claude/*auth*" -type f -delete 2>/dev/null and find ~/Library -path "*/claude/*auth*" -type f -delete 2>/dev/null
User runs ls -la ~/.config/claude/skills/ and receives error indicating directory does not exist
System identifies that the entire claude directory may have been deleted, suggests emergency recovery steps including checking backups, using data recovery tools, and reconfiguring
User inspects claude.json configuration file, which includes skillUsage data showing skills are still present
System explains that skills are stored in claude.json, not in a separate skills directory, and confirms skills are not deleted
System instructs user to verify claude.json exists with ls -la ~/.config/claude/claude.json
